title: DOW-UAP-D28, Mission Report, Iraq, September 2024
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from USCENTCOM detailing a UAP observation during a weapons calibration exercise in Iraq, featuring significant redactions under 1.4(a) and FOIA exemptions.

incidents.summary: During a weapons calibration test in Iraq, a U.S. military aircraft crew observed an unidentified object moving at a high rate of speed through their IR sensor field-of-view immediately following the release of an AGM-176 missile.
incidents.location_name: Ayn al Asad Airbase (AAAB) Restricted Operating Zone (ROZ) Raindrop
incidents.quote: observed an unidentified object "fly" through the aircraft sensors at a high rate of speed
